title: repo-presenter supervisor instruction line
description: One line of ops/instructions.jsonl. Supervisor appends only, via gatecli. card_sha256 pins the card the worker was dispatched against, so a worker editing its own card cannot redefine its own permissions. Ported near-verbatim from foss-mcp's schemas/instruction-line.schema.json (2026-10-21) -- no foss-mcp-specific content.

successor.description: Only for kind supersede: the accepted card that carries this card's work.

lease.description: Only on lines written by gatecli dispatch-next / worker-tick (owner ruling R8, 2026-11-06): the single worker lease. A dispatch line acquires it, a rework line renews it after a failed independent verify, lease_release ends it on a verdict (accepted / failed_internal), lease_expired ends it when the holder went silent past expires_at -- the card then returns to READY.
